notes.title: NON VR PLAY!!! A huge update to the free demo and closed alpha. (Also HOTAS!)
notes.notes:
Its a big day for Inter Solar 83 as finally I can offer access to the game to the other 98% of steam users!

From his point on the game will be playable both in VR and on a monitor, with a full interface conversion for each. This was the most requested feature by far. The second most requested feature, support of HOTAS and game controllers has also been added.... along with many other new features!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245589/e96a94a54f6e7face79ca1b55e4d3793e6ad4e18.jpg"]

The patch notes....

Non VR play!

Inter Solar 83 is finally available to everyone, not just those with VR headsets!



HOTAS and game controller support.

The No.1 most requested feature, you can now just a HOTAS or other game controller(s) to fly your ship. Available in both VR and non VR play.



Control remapping

Set up any controller or keyboard input to a huge range of ship functions.

(this will also allow you to set up voice attack or similar third party software).



Overhauled star map

The star map should now load instantly (no more game freezes) and has had a full graphical overhaul.



New music

A much larger selection of fantastic 80s inspired tracks bring extra atmosphere to the game.



New ship locator compass

Tured of losing your ship on the surface of planets? Just use the handy new pointer!



Updated wrist computer.

New graphics and features to allow interation with the compass, bindings and graphics menu.



Updated save system.

The auto save now saves everything, from inventory contents to ammo count.



New graphics

From new hyperspace effects to an updated space suit.



New menus

An overhaul of the main menu to make things slicker and easier to use. VR and Non VR.



Many bug fixes

A lot of persistent bugs have now been fixed, along with crushing some new ones that turned up.



Optimisation

A sweep of the game tuning various features to improve framerate for VR and non VR players.

notes.title: Huge Update to the Alpha!
notes.notes:
The latest update to the closed alpha is now live! This one was a lot of work as it needed entirely new back end code for generating planetary rings, managing inventories and resources and physics-based projectiles! I'm hopeful the next patch will move much faster as it will build on these new features.


 New Features Include:
 New asteroid models and generation system.
 Rework of gas giant rings to include millions of asteroids and dust clouds.
 Deployable/retractible  mining laser.
 An 8-bit game to play on your console!
 A new inventory system.
 New cargo console to collect and dispense items.
 New models and cockpit detail.
 Enhanced planet graphics.
 New sound effects.
 Streamlining and optimization.
 Bug fixes.


Again, many thanks to the paid backers who have made working on this project possible. If you'd like to join them and get immediate access to this build click here!

notes.title: July Patch Now Live for Backers
notes.notes:
Its patch day! The July patch is now live and being played by backers. Get in on the action here - https://firsttimegames.com

This adds the following features...

· Dynamic temperature system
· Temperature effects on ship
· Climate control system including new control panel, interactions and sound effects.
· Power consumption system - you now need to monitor power use, and recharge to avoid your ship shutting down completely!
· Updated power unit readout screen
· Updated sound effects for ship engines
· New environmental sound effects
· New dynamic star light and heat - distance and line of sight now effect heat absorbed from sunlight. You will notice dramatic drops in temperature when orbiting on the dark side of a planet.
· Updated lighting system to correctly block sunlight when in shadow of a planet.
· Fixed bug with suns showing through landscape
· Many other minor bug fixes

notes.title: June Update Now Live! New graphics, New Models, New Features! (Demo and Alpha)
notes.notes:
The latest patch adds the following new features.

Settings:

Switch music on/off

Select dedicated mode for HTC Vive wands

Select snap or smooth turning

 

Game:

Suns have been completely overhauled both in terms of generation and graphics. You should now see much more realistic looking local stars with accurate representations of real main sequence stars.

Starlight now correctly adjusts brightness in the cockpit according to star type.

Periscope switch updated and now include lock for hyperspace

Overhead panel switches now lock at appropriate times and have new labels and indicator lights.

Navigation computer should now display the names of local bodies correctly including number and letter designation for Stars, planets and moons for example...

System Delta 467

Delta 467-A (Type M Star)

Delta 467-A 1 (Barren Planet)

Delta 467-A 1a (Ice Moon)


Demo/tutorial has been updated to add some more recent features of the alpha.

Many many bug fixes!

I hope enjoy the new features! I'm currently working on some more back end code to bring game saving to (hopefully) the next patch.

Joe

notes.title: Huge update to graphics and gameplay!
notes.notes:
I've been hard at work for a month on this one, hopefully you'll like it!

This is a complete re-work of the planet terrain and graphics along with some major overhauls on how you move around the planet. Also many, many smaller changes.

Graphics

 Completely re-worked the terrain and textures to be much more interesting and detailed
 Added scattered rocks to Moon
 Added shadow casting on planet surface from ship and other objects
 Added dust cloud around moon
 Added dust kick-up graphics and sound effects
 Re-built lighting and shadows inside ship
 New graphics for computer screens
 


Features

 Added space gauntlet with interactive holo menu.


Gameplay

 Overhauled ship speed relative to height above surface
 Optimised many features to improve frame rate (still work in progress, don't worry!)
 Re-built player controller on planet surface, movement/jumping vastly improved.
 

...and many, many small changes to numerous to list!

Hopefully this should feel like a bit jump in look and feel.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.05 - Optimization, frame rate and space gloves!
notes.notes:
Greetings Explorers!

An important patch today which should see a big improvement on frame rates for many users. A lot of optimization work has been done in the background.

But! Who wants a patch with nothing you can actually see in it?! No-one! So that's why you also have a very stylish pair of space gloves. These are idea for tapping space buttons, looking cool in space bars and "Flying Casual".

notes.title: Small update - New, more intuitive control stick.
notes.notes:
Greetings explorers!

Just a very small update to the alpha demo today replacing the joystick with a more intuitive model that better matches the tracked motion controller. It should be more clear that flight is operated by tilting the controller, rather than moving it around.

The thumb pad is now also represented on the top of the joystick to make that feature clearer.

I hope you enjoy the upgrade!

notes.title: Hotfix update for Demo - Version 1.02
notes.notes:
Greetings Explorers!

Another small patch for the demo today to address a few issues. Mainly to correct some control problems with the Valve Index.

Full list of changes....


Ship environment

 Joystick system completely overhealed and rebuilt. The virtual H.O.T.A.S style joystick should now function correctly on all systems, not just Oculus!
 Fixed engine audio bug.



Flight Model

 Adjusted directional thruster power to be less extreme, making landing easier.


Planetary engine

 Rock spawning temporarily disabled due to mystery bug causing rocks to roam the surface! On the list for the next patch.
 Adjusted planetary rotation speed for small moon.


Menus

 Updated menu text to replcet current alpha state and version.


If you have issues with this patch, or find the previous version worked better for you (Oculus players should use either version fine) then the previous version 1.01 can be found in the betas tab.

notes.title: Hotfix update for Demo - Version 1.01
notes.notes:
Greetings Explorers!

Many thanks for the great feedback and bug reports. Here are a few initial fixes to sort the most pressing items, especially the issue with the old landing gear not deploying correctly. I took the decision to simply replace the (frankly unreliable) push lever with a button, which is now positioned beneath the landing gear indicator lights (where it actually makes sense to have the control!). The old lever has gone... but I suspect it will return with a new function later as its a nice model!

Full list of changes....

Planetary engine

 Planetary rotation implemented - you can now enjoy watching a gas giant rise over the hills!


Player (planet surface)

 Player movement speed increased
 Adjusted jump power


Ship environment

 Landing gear lever replaced with button
 Landing gear locked warning lights and buzzer implemented


Menus

 Fixed fade to black on main menu
 Updated menu text to replcet current alpha state and version



Notes
I am aware of a bug with the joystick preventing correct use with the left hand and am looking into it further (as it makes no sense at all!) Currently only the right hand can twist the joystick for Yaw control.

This and other requests / bugs will form part of future patches.
